prompts.title: Public library loan desk

No boundary component connects directly to durable state.

must_not_include.statement: The five-book limit is not left to the member-facing entry point.

Exclusions: Only one branch and modest traffic are stated, so no read-heavy load justifies caching. No static or media delivery is described; the loan desk handles records, not content delivery.
